chapter: Buck's Legion band and later gigs
title: Pay at the Legion: percentage deal versus union scale
summary: Percentage deal, union scale of $13, and the cover charge.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: They were, well, planes. Sometimes a dollar, a dollar and a half. And they were on a commission. And then the war broke out. They were, was making between $25 and $30 a man a night. Was that from the kiddie? No, just from the kiddie. It was a 60-40 deal.
Oh, oh, I see. You were on a percentage, huh? Yeah.
And then the union stepped in and said, no, you all have to play for the scale, which was $13 at the time. So, we had to play for the scale. Like we had some, we had some fine crowds there.
Did they always charge to get in? Yeah.
I think it was 50 or 60 cents per man, about 35 cents per woman. Yeah. It was a good deal.
